name: Harvest Skill Actions
description: Handles Promote / Promote shared / Reject / View draft buttons on skill-harvester proposal cards in Discord. Companion to lib/notify.sh notify_harvest_skill_discord (openclaw presentation path).

allowedUserIds.description: Discord user IDs allowed to click harvest buttons. Empty = refuse all (default-deny). Overrides WARDEN_DISCORD_ALLOWED_USER_IDS when set.
